## Notes

Dimensions are stated as supplied (Height × Width × Depth) for the outer carton/crate; weights are gross. Quantities have been set so that, in aggregate, the order requires close to a 50-van fleet at the stated interior dimensions; 49 of the 50 lines are sized to roughly one van-equivalent of volume each (a realistic, evenly spread load), while Line 50 is intentionally loaded with a very high quantity of small cartons to test how the loading software renders and packs a dense, repetitive single-item van. Fleet sizing is the higher of the volume-basis and weight-basis calculations; actual achievable load-per-van will be lower than the theoretical interior volume once stacking gaps, fragile separation, and load-securing space are accounted for — the figures above should be treated as a planning estimate, not a guaranteed packing result.
